# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are made against the latest published version of Pandion
Plots.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not describe a suspected vulnerability in a public issue.
Instead, use GitHub's private
[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/torryscott/pandion/security/advisories/new)
form.

Include the affected Pandion version and format, the potential impact,
and the smallest set of steps needed to reproduce the problem. Use
synthetic data and remove personal, institutional, or research
information before attaching files.

Ordinary bugs and feature requests can continue to use the public
[issue tracker](https://github.com/torryscott/pandion/issues).
